title: NCRIC onward disclosures of SMPD data
summary:
NCRIC's published Flock transparency portal (captured 2026-04-25) lists 319 outbound recipients, three of which are private institutions: University of the Pacific, Stanford University PD, and University of San Francisco PD.

SMPD's 2014 MOU with NCRIC §9 grants NCRIC authority to add member agencies and incorporate new sharing systems without further review or approval by member agencies. §6 names the contributing member agency as the official custodian of contributed information.

This request asks what SMPD data has flowed through NCRIC to downstream recipients, and what SMPD records describe identifying or restricting that flow.

policy_promises.quote: ALPR information shall not be sold, shared, or transferred except to another public agency
policy_promises.tests: What records describe SMPD's role in approving, monitoring, or restricting NCRIC's onward sharing chain?

policy_promises.quote: Member Agencies remain the official custodian of all information contributed to the NCRIC-DSP
policy_promises.tests: What records of NCRIC's onward sharing of SMPD data are accessible to SMPD as the custodian?

prior_pra_refs.note: W012376 produced the 2014 NCRIC MOU and 'no responsive records' for SMPD restrictions on NCRIC re-sharing. This request asks for records reachable through SMPD's role as custodian of contributed data.

filed_because: Surfaces what SMPD records exist for the data flow from SMPD through NCRIC to its downstream recipients.
notes:
Like W012570-041926 and W012664-050426, this request invokes records held on SMPD's behalf — backed by MSA §4.1, Policy 463 (§§ 463.2, 463.5), SOP 205.5.1, and the NCRIC MOU §6 custodian provision.

Response received 2026-05-14 (Juliana Santiago, Management Analyst, SMPD). Closed same day.
